end.summary: Recognised halves, thirds and quarters of shapes in 5 attempts; 2 were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying equal shares and naming halves, thirds and quarters using food and shape examples. Nisha correctly used equal-sized parts to identify one-third and one-quarter in the final examples. They mixed up the denominator with the number of parts left; this was not fully corrected by the last time it appeared. At home, draw shapes split into equal parts and ask, “How many equal parts make the whole?”
